content:
In LaTeX, the `\rowcolor` command is part of the `colortbl` package and is used to color entire rows in a table. Here's a comprehensive overview:

1. Basic Usage:
```latex
\usepackage{colortbl}
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\rowcolor{lightgray}
Item 1 & Item 2 & Item 3 \\
Normal row 1 & Data & Data \\
\end{tabular}
```

2. Multiple Color Options:
```latex
\rowcolor[gray]{0.8}  % Grayscale
\rowcolor[RGB]{255,200,200}  % RGB color
\rowcolor{red!20}  % Percentage color
```

3. Specifying Row Position:
```latex
\rowcolor{yellow}[1]  % Color specific row
```

4. Full Example:
```latex
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{colortbl}
\usepackage{xcolor}

\begin{document}
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{lightgray} Header 1 & Header 2 & Header 3 \\
\hline
\rowcolor{yellow!20} Data 1 & Data 2 & Data 3 \\
\hline
Normal Row & More Data & More Data \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{document}
```

Key points:
- Requires `colortbl` package
- Can use various color specifications
- Works well with `xcolor` package for more color options
